  import type { Feature } from "../blocks/feature-grid.types";

  export type FeatureRowsProps = {
    features: Feature[];
    mediaSide?: "end" | "start" | "alternate";

</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../compose/Box.svelte";
  import Grid from "../compose/Grid.svelte";

  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";

<Stack gap="8" align="stretch" data-slot="feature-rows">
  {#each features as feature (feature.id)}
    <Grid cols="1-2" class="group items-center gap-8" data-slot="feature-card">
      <Stack gap="2" class="min-w-0">
        <LucideIcon name={feature.icon} size={24} />
        <Title as={3} size="xl" weight="bold">
          {feature.title}
        </Title>
        <Text size="base" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {feature.text}
        </Text>
      </Stack>
      <Box
        class={cn(
          "w-full min-w-0",
          (
            (mediaSide as string) === "start" ? "md:order-first"
            : (mediaSide as string) === "alternate" ? "md:group-even:order-first"

          )

        <MediaFrame alt={feature.title} ratio="4/3" />
